# Navigation argument constraints:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/navigation_functions.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/numbering_functions.md
# Error messages agree with GoogleSQL's analytic_lag/lead/nth_value/ntile tests.
DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT -1;
SELECT LAG(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The offset to the function LAG must not be negative

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT LAG(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The offset to the function LAG must not be null

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT -1;
SELECT LEAD(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The offset to the function LEAD must not be negative

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT LEAD(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The offset to the function LEAD must not be null

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT NTH_VALUE(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The N value for the NthValue function must not be NULL

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT 0;
SELECT NTH_VALUE(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The N value for the NthValue function must be positive

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT -1;
SELECT NTH_VALUE(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The N value for the NthValue function must be positive

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT NTILE(n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The N value (number of buckets) for the NTILE function must not be NULL

# Zero is valid for LAG/LEAD but not for NTH_VALUE/NTILE.
DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT 0;
SELECT LAG(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([7]) AS x
=> "7"

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT 0;
SELECT LEAD(x, n) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([7]) AS x
=> "7"

# LIMIT/OFFSET: GoogleSQL compliance testdata/limit_queries.test.
DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x LIMIT n
=> error: Limit requires non-null count and offset

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT NULL;
SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x LIMIT 1 OFFSET n
=> error: Limit requires non-null count and offset

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT -1;
SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x LIMIT n
=> error: Limit requires non-negative count and offset

DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT -1;
SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x LIMIT 1 OFFSET n
=> error: Limit requires non-negative count and offset
